description: This file defines the ParagraphIterator class within the MigraDoc.Rendering namespace, responsible for iterating through paragraph elements and document objects in a document rendering context. It provides methods to traverse, seek, and analyze the leaf nodes of a paragraph's element tree.

classes.name: ParagraphIterator
classes.description: A class for sequential traversal of paragraph elements and document objects within a paragraph in the MigraDoc document rendering process.

methods.name: ParagraphIterator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the iterator with a root node and optionally current node and position indices.

methods.name: GetLastLeaf
methods.description: Returns the last leaf node in the document object tree rooted at the specified node.

methods.name: GetFirstLeaf
methods.description: Returns the first leaf node in the document object tree rooted at the specified node.

methods.name: GetNextLeaf
methods.description: Returns the next leaf node following the current node in document order.

methods.name: GetPreviousLeaf
methods.description: Returns the previous leaf node preceding the current node in document order.

methods.name: GetNodeObject
methods.description: Resolves a specific document object to its underlying renderable element, such as TextElements or Hyperlink elements.

methods.name: SeekLastLeaf
methods.description: Private method to navigate down to the deepest last leaf from the current node.

methods.name: SeekFirstLeaf
methods.description: Private method to navigate down to the earliest first leaf from the current node.

methods.name: GetParentIterator
methods.description: Retrieves a parent iterator corresponding to the current node's parent element.

methods.name: LastIndex
methods.description: Property returning the last index in the position indices list.
